control.mechanism: No persistence dependency on the current chart path plus Python file-write API regression guards.

claims.statement: 目前 /api/chart application path 不使用出生資料資料庫、session store、request cache或background queue，並以Python write guard監看目前同步處理路徑。

control.mechanism: Closed event builder plus sink-side schema validation and non-propagating dedicated logger.

limitations: Future logger or telemetry changes require a new privacy review and canary test.

excludes: reverse proxy, hosting supervisor and third-party telemetry

claims.statement: Application營運事件由封閉欄位與封閉 vocabulary重建，不直接序列化request、response、header或exception。

control.mechanism: Low-level ASGI middleware contains pre-start and post-start Exception paths and isolates event-sink failures.

limitations: Post-response-start failures cannot rewrite an HTTP status already sent on the wire.

applies_to: current FastAPI application wrapped by PrivacyBoundaryMiddleware
excludes: transport failures outside the application boundary

claims.statement: 目前ASGI application boundary以固定錯誤回應與完整response-lifecycle containment避免原始exception進入response或Uvicorn traceback。

control.mechanism: scripts/local/run-local.sh passes an explicit --no-access-log argument and real-launcher canaries inspect process output.

limitations: Startup and shutdown messages remain visible in the local terminal.

applies_to: start.command and scripts/local/run-local.sh canonical local runtime
excludes: future reverse proxy, CDN, WAF and hosting logs

claims.statement: Canonical本機launcher以--no-access-log啟動Uvicorn，避免request line與query進入Uvicorn access output。

control.mechanism: Central lifecycle controller, request generation checks, AbortController, result clear, panic clear and pagehide clear.

limitations: autocomplete=off is a browser hint, not an enforcement API.

applies_to: current same-origin frontend calculation and export UI

calculation_trace.title: UTC -> 儒略日 (swe.utc_to_jd)

calculation_trace.formula: ECL_NUT 回傳 [真黃赤交角, 平黃赤交角, 黃經章動, 交角章動]
calculation_trace.title: 黃赤交角與章動 (swe.calc_ut ECL_NUT)

calculation_trace.formula: GAST = swe.sidtime(JD_UT)；GMST = swe.sidtime0(JD_UT, 平黃赤交角, 0)；LAST/LMST = GAST/GMST + 東經/15
calculation_trace.note: 舊欄位 gst_hours/lst_hours 為向後相容 alias，固定等同 GAST/LAST。
calculation_trace.title: 平均／視恆星時 (Sidereal Time)

calculation_trace.formula: 真太陽時 = UTC + 經度/15(小時) + 均時差；均時差 = swe.time_equ(JD_UT) * 1440 分鐘
calculation_trace.note: 此為輔助資訊；本次時鐘值只是代表計算錨點，不是實際出生時刻
calculation_trace.title: 均時差與真太陽時（僅供參考，不影響本次計算）

degree_based.partile_note: 三種慣例並存且會給出不同答案，其中兩種都出自 Lilly 本人（1647 同度、1677 三度以內）。預設採最通行的同度慣例，可經 partile_profile 改選。

partile_profile_detail.note: Houlding 記為最通行的用法。兩星必須落在各自星座的同一個整數度，與角距離無關。
sources: William Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647) Book I p.107

partile_source_verification.tabulated_from: Deborah Houlding, Skyscript glossary 'Partile / Platick' (secondary), quoting Lilly's Christian Astrology 1647 p.107 and Merlini Anglici 1677

traditional_seven_domicile_exaltation_si.source: Ptolemy, Tetrabiblos I.17 and I.19, Frank E. Robbins trans. (Loeb 1940); sign assignments corroborated by Dorotheus Carmen Astrologicum I.1-2, Valens Anthologies III.4, and Firmicus Maternus Mathesis II.2-3
traditional_seven_domicile_exaltation_si.source_scope_note: Ptolemy I.17 and I.19 support the sign-level output used here. The corroborating Dorotheus, Valens, and Firmicus passages also transmit exact-degree traditions that this profile deliberately does not evaluate; their inclusion does not imply that ancient traditions were sign-only.

library_info.note: 兩者是不同的版本號：前者是 pip 安裝的 pyswisseph 套件版本，後者是其內建 Swiss Ephemeris C 函式庫自報的版本，數字格式相近但並非同一個值。tz_database 是本地時間換算所用的 IANA 時區資料庫版本，它不由本產品固定：macOS 由作業系統提供、容器由 image 提供，更新後同一組輸入可能換算出不同的 UTC。
